name: Fatal Seduction
description: A married professor is pulled into a passionate affair with a younger man that uncovers a path of tragedy and betrayal from those closest to her.

videos.title: Mister Wrong
videos.overview: Grappling with a miscarriage and her husband's secrecy, university professor Nandi Mahlati crosses paths with a younger man during a weekend trip.

videos.title: Through the Wound
videos.overview: A disturbing death triggers an investigation into Nandi and Brenda's trip. Jacob's presence in her life sends Nandi's desire into overdrive.

videos.title: Committed
videos.overview: Vuyo reflects on memories with Brenda. After receiving an anonymous text, Zinhle grows closer to her new friend. Nandi considers life without Leonard.

videos.title: Who Is Jacob Tau?
videos.overview: Leonard attempts to rekindle his and Nandi's waning romance. Suspicions around Jacob emerge when Vuyo finds an incriminating link to the past.

videos.title: Denial
videos.overview: Nandi's distance angers Jacob as he encroaches upon her life. Zinhle tracks down PokébOi, while Leonard tries to protect his own interests.

videos.title: Caned
videos.overview: As Jacob's behavior takes a menacing turn, Nandi is forced to choose between her family and justice for Brenda. Vuyo takes matters into his own hands.

videos.title: The Truth Shall Break You
videos.overview: Mistrustful of Nandi's fidelity, Leonard goes down a dark path. Devastating revelations around an old murder case finally emerge.

videos.title: Psychopath
videos.overview: Vuyo confronts Leonard about Brenda's death. Nandi and Leonard reconcile. Jacob initiates a plan for revenge involving Zinhle.

videos.title: Nothing Is as It Seems
videos.overview: A desperate search for Zinhle ends in surprise and embarrassment. Leonard receives a mysterious letter at work that sends him spiraling.

videos.title: Confrontation
videos.overview: Vuyo reveals concerning truths to Nandi that make her question everything she knows about her husband. Zinhle overhears an explosive argument.

videos.title: Sins of the Past
videos.overview: Another mysterious death sends detectives into overdrive. Zinhle sees something that she can't unsee.

videos.title: My Brother's Keeper
videos.overview: The authorities make a shocking arrest in the reopened murder case of Benjamin Jiba. Jacob gets a once in a lifetime chance to start over.

videos.title: One More Lie
videos.overview: Detectives come knocking on Nandi's door. Zinhle makes a move on a friend. Leonard and Vuyo concoct a scheme to get him out of trouble.

videos.title: Outplayed (Season Finale)
videos.overview: In the unsettling conclusion to this chapter, Nandi tries to come clean once and for all. Vuyo reveals his intentions, while Zinhle is caught in the middle.

videos.title: The Sins Of The Father
videos.overview: Nandi is forced to rely on her own defenses when Phila is released on parole, but a threat to Zinhle's life leaves her feeling more helpless than ever.

videos.title: Tearing Down The Walls
videos.overview: Distressed and hospitalized, Zinhle begs to see her mother. In desperation, Vuyo turns to dark solutions hoping to get Nandi's charges dropped.

videos.title: Sand Through The Fingers
videos.overview: After finding a damning recording, Zinhle confronts Vuyo about his secrecy around Brenda's death. A friend from prison pays Nandi an unexpected visit.

videos.title: Twenty Four Hours
videos.overview: When Vuyo refuses to cooperate and give in to demands, blackmail drives Nandi to take matters into her own hands, along with Phila's faithful help.

videos.title: Remember To Forget
videos.overview: With gaps in Leonard's memory, Nandi takes the opportunity to rewrite her family's story in a positive light. Precious struggles to move past her trauma.

videos.title: Behind The Mask
videos.overview: Zinhle struggles to see her mother in the same light, when Phila steps into the picture. Precious asks Jacob to keep their relationship private.

videos.title: The Boy Next Door
videos.overview: Leonard reels over the aftermath of his actions, unable to shake the flashbacks of memories. Vilakazi shows up uninvited, questioning Precious's loyalty.

videos.title: The Deputy President
videos.overview: Vilakazi tightens the leash on both Nandi and Precious, when he suspects that they may be involved more intimately with Jacob behind his back.

videos.title: A Happy New Year
videos.overview: Precious's regrets run six feet deep as she faces the consequences of her actions. Zinhle's decisions have her waking up in bed with her own mistakes.

videos.title: Pain
videos.overview: As the truth begins to spill over, Vilakazi's wife is unable to stomach her husband's misdeeds. Clinton and Zinhle find themselves in the lion's den.

videos.title: Woman Drowning
videos.overview: Nandi finally leaves her troubles behind her, while Vuyo — now trapped with the very people he incarcerated — finds himself in a world of trouble.

videos.title: The Bachelorette
videos.overview: A delivery of wedding invitations unsettles the Mahlati household. Can Nandi resist getting to the bottom of the unexpected announcement herself?

videos.title: Foul Play
videos.overview: In the wake of sudden tragedy, Leonard and Nandi share an unspeakable secret with each other, and Jacob is once again faced with a heartbreaking loss.

videos.title: Witnessed
videos.overview: With condemning security footage of potential suspects and DNA samples in evidence, Leonard and Nandi find themselves at the mercy of others again.

videos.title: The Prime Suspect
videos.overview: Vuyo's quiet release from prison puts the Mahlatis into a state of distress, but Thuso makes her move for justice when she receives an anonymous tip.

videos.title: Outlaws
videos.overview: In light of new evidence, Thuso's nationwide manhunt for Jacob and Nandi begins. The pair decide to pay Vuyo one last visit before disappearing for good.

videos.title: The Innocent Don'T Run
videos.overview: When Nandi notices a familiar face in the footage of Kim's party, she suddenly has a feeling that there is more to this murder than meets the eye.

videos.title: The Therapist
videos.overview: Disgruntled by Nandi's lies, Lunga tips Thuso off about her whereabouts. Thuso finally catches up with Nandi… but she is more slippery than ever.

videos.title: Revelations
videos.overview: A troubling old flame haunts Jacob's memories. Leonard is forced to make Thuso an offer she can't refuse, after begging her to drop Zinhle's suspension.

videos.title: This Is The End
videos.overview: Shocking news about Leonard gives Nandi the pause she needs to make a clean getaway, but will Jacob be able to wash the stains of guilt off his own hands?

videos.title: Letting Go
videos.overview: Everything goes up in flames as Nandi finally comes face-to-face with Sandra yet again. Jacob's life is now on the line... and the clock is ticking.
